system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a Kubernetes Deployment manifest for a Python 3.12 API service (image: myorg/api:1.4.2) with 2 replicas, exposing port 8080.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Write a Kubernetes Deployment manifest for a Python 3.12 API service (image: myorg/api:1.4.2) with 2 replicas, exposing port 8080.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: api-service
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: iac
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 25%
      maxUnavailable: 25%
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: api
  minReadySeconds: 5
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 600
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: api
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.4.2"
        app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        runAsGroup: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: api
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app.kubernetes.io/name: api
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: myorg/api:1.4.2
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          env:
            - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: "512Mi"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 3
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 2
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
